supporting_quotes.exact: A binary tree is a tree data structure in which each parent node can have at most two children. Each node of a binary tree consists of three items:

observations.subject: binary tree
observations.object: a tree data structure in which each parent node can have at most two children; each node consists of three items

claims.rationale: evidence-fc3cd706c50d[0,147] 直接包含 claim 的'至多两个孩子'（'each parent node can have at most two children'）与'三部分'（'consists of three items'）；evidence-99ac291d5c8f[0,21] 与 evidence-445127cc9c8d[0,22] 分别给出'address of left child'与'address of right child'。但 claim 的'数据项'成分在三条引文中均无对应文字，仅能由'three items'+两个地址项间接推断，属引文未直接覆盖的成分；其余成分均被引文直接支持，故 partially_supported（advisory）。注：本次请求未提供源文档全文，start/end 为所提供引文文本内的偏移。

supporting_quotes.exact: A full Binary tree is a special type of binary tree in which every parent node/internal node has either two or no children.

observations.subject: full binary tree
observations.object: a special type of binary tree in which every parent/internal node has either two or no children

claims.rationale: evidence-c07bf1606108[0,123]：'special type of binary tree in which every parent node/internal node has either two or no children'与 claim'满二叉树是一种特殊类型：每个父节点/内部节点要么有两个孩子，要么没有孩子'逐项一致（either two or no children ↔ 要么两个要么没有；parent node/internal node ↔ 父节点/内部节点），无缺失或冲突成分，supported。

supporting_quotes.exact: A perfect binary tree is a type of binary tree in which every internal node has exactly two child nodes and all the leaf nodes are at the same level.

observations.subject: perfect binary tree
observations.object: a binary tree in which every internal node has exactly two child nodes and all leaf nodes are at the same level

claims.rationale: evidence-4715bfc4048b[0,149]：'every internal node has exactly two child nodes and all the leaf nodes are at the same level'逐项对应 claim'每个内部节点恰有两个孩子，且所有叶节点在同一层'（exactly two ↔ 恰两个；same level ↔ 同一层），supported。

supporting_quotes.exact: A complete binary tree is just like a full binary tree, but with two major differences
Every level must be completely filled
All the leaf elements must lean towards the left.
The last leaf element might not have a right sibling i.e. a complete binary tree doesn't have to be a full binary tree.

observations.subject: complete binary tree
observations.object: a full binary tree, with two major differences

observations.subject: last leaf element
observations.object: a right sibling; a complete binary tree need not be a full binary tree

claims.rationale: 四条引文逐一支持 claim 各成分：evidence-10b8acb00371[0,86]'just like a full binary tree, but with two major differences'↔'与满二叉树相似但有两点不同'；evidence-1a26cf6fb16b[0,36]'Every level must be completely filled'↔'每一层必须被完全填满'；evidence-4e2930adcd59[0,49]'All the leaf elements must lean towards the left.'↔'所有叶元素倾向左侧'；evidence-696f990f0af4[0,119]'The last leaf element might not have a right sibling i.e. a complete binary tree doesn't have to be a full binary tree.'↔'最后一个叶元素可能没有右兄弟（不必是满二叉树）'。claim 在'两点不同'下并列三项性质系复述源文结构（末项属补充说明），各成分均有直接引文，无冲突，supported。

supporting_quotes.exact: A degenerate or pathological tree is the tree having a single child either left or right.
A skewed binary tree is a pathological/degenerate tree in which the tree is either dominated by the left nodes or the right nodes.

observations.subject: degenerate or pathological tree
observations.object: a tree having a single child, either left or right

observations.subject: skewed binary tree
observations.object: a pathological/degenerate tree dominated by the left nodes or the right nodes

claims.rationale: evidence-b0ed47f947f1[0,87]：'having a single child either left or right'↔'每个节点只有一个孩子（左或右）'，且 degenerate/pathological ↔ 退化树/病态树；evidence-4e587942c165[0,129]：'pathological/degenerate tree in which the tree is either dominated by the left nodes or the right nodes'↔'被左节点或右节点主导的退化树'，其 either/or 二选一结构即为'分左歪斜与右歪斜两类'的直接依据。两项引文均直接命中 claim，supported。

supporting_quotes.exact: It is a type of binary tree in which the difference between the height of the left and the right subtree for each node is either 0 or 1.

observations.subject: balanced binary tree
observations.object: a binary tree in which the height difference between left and right subtrees for each node is 0 or 1

claims.rationale: evidence-1717ba8ee2fd[0,135]：'the difference between the height of the left and the right subtree for each node is either 0 or 1'与 claim'每个节点的左子树与右子树高度差为 0 或 1'完全对应（height of left/right subtree ↔ 左右子树高度；either 0 or 1 ↔ 0 或 1），supported。

supporting_quotes.exact: A node of a binary tree is represented by a structure containing a data part and two pointers to other structures of the same type.

observations.subject: binary tree node
observations.object: a structure containing a data part and two pointers to other structures of the same type

claims.rationale: evidence-b182c79f5138[0,130]：'a structure containing a data part and two pointers to other structures of the same type'与 claim'包含一个数据部分和两个指向同类型结构指针的结构体'逐项一致（data part ↔ 数据部分；two pointers to other structures of the same type ↔ 两个指向同类型结构指针），supported。
